explanation: The equation ∇f=(8x,-2y)=0 gives (0,0), which lies on the boundary, so there are no interior critical points. On (x-1)²+y²=1, Lagrange multipliers give 8x=2λ(x-1) and -2y=2λy. If y=0, then x=0 or 2, giving values 0 and 16. Otherwise λ=-1, so x=1/5 and y=±3/5, giving -1/5. Thus the maximum is 16 at (2,0).
